fato_historico: 1969: The 1969 Somali coup d'état establishes a Marxist–Leninist administration.
energia_do_dia: Today, your Gemini spirit may feel a sudden shift toward transformation, much like a total systemic rewrite of your internal landscape. It is a good time to consider how changing your foundations can lead to growth. Perhaps you should welcome fresh perspectives as you reorganize your daily routines with the curiosity of a seeker chasing a lucky four-leaf clover.
frase_do_dia: New chapters begin when you bravely welcome the shift in your personal atmosphere.
significado_numero: Represents the dawn of a new cycle and individual transformation.
conselho: Stay open to sudden changes; they may lead you to unexpected hidden treasures.
